actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: speak with beasts and plants
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .mmVineLash000000]] or [[/item .mmThornBurst0000]] attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast [[/item .mmSpellcasting00.Activity.bAmZSyK4cn33HwwI]].

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAnimalFrie]{Animal Friendship}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCharmMonst]{Charm Monster} (lasts 24 hours; ends early if the dryad casts the spell again), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDruidcraft]{Druidcraft} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplEntangle00]{Entangle}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPasswithou]{Pass without Trace}

actions.name: tree stride
actions.desc: If within [[lookup @range.value activity=8av8Lh1jNLCrOJny]] feet of a [[lookup @range.special activity=8av8Lh1jNLCrOJny]], the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} teleports to an unoccupied space within [[lookup @range.value activity=8av8Lh1jNLCrOJny]] feet of a second [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=8av8Lh1jNLCrOJny]] that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.
